countries.name: United Kingdom
countries.stock_text: United Kingdom warehouse, ready to dispatch
ordering: Find the product and open its reference link to check the photos, size, variation and full description.
Choose the option and quantity, add it to your order, and enter the recipient's delivery details.
Review and send the order request. Ravisn Ltd confirms stock, price and delivery with you before payment.
Pay in full. Your order is confirmed once payment clears.
Send your shipping labels by 9:00 PM Pakistan time for same-day dispatch.
Your parcels are handed to the courier and tracking begins on scan.

items.title: Order by code
items.body: Order using the Product Code only. Codes are how we identify the exact item, variant and warehouse.

items.title: Match the listing link
items.body: Order the exact product shown in the listing link: same size, ml/oz, weight, capsule or tablet count. If the item you send us differs from the linked product in size, weight or variant, that is your responsibility.

items.title: Quantities
items.body: Quantities shown with + are the minimum available. Other quantities are the latest figures we have and change during the day. Stock is confirmed on WhatsApp before payment; first confirmed, first served.

items.title: Status meanings
items.body: “Available” is ready to dispatch. “Available without label” is ready to dispatch without its retail label. “Available in bulk” is ready to dispatch for bulk orders. “Available on demand” is supplied on request. Confirm availability on WhatsApp before ordering. “Available in 10 days” is expected to be ready to dispatch within 10 days. “In transit” is stock on its way to the warehouse. “Out of stock” items cannot be ordered until restocked.

items.title: What the price includes
items.body: Prices are FBM rates: product cost with free pick, pack and drop. Shipping labels are provided by you and are not included in the price.

items.title: Single / Pack / FBA
items.body: Where a price shows Single, Pack and FBA figures, those are the per-unit rates for each option. Single is one piece, Pack is the sealed multi-pack, FBA is the bulk rate for Amazon fulfilment stock.

items.title: Prices change
items.body: Prices follow the market and are valid for the day of enquiry only. The price confirmed on WhatsApp at order time is the price you pay.

items.title: Bulk orders
items.body: Bulk quantities (12 pieces or more of one product) may qualify for reduced rates. Ask on WhatsApp before ordering.

items.title: No invoices
items.body: Products are supplied without brand invoices or documents, except where the product name states “with brand invoice”. Bulk-category products (marked “UK Stock - Bulk”) are supplied without invoices.

items.title: Accepted labels
items.body: Only Royal Mail Tracked 24 / Tracked 48 and Evri labels are accepted. Royal Mail labels must be Small Parcel format. Large Letter and Small Letter labels are not accepted.

items.title: Daily cut-off
items.body: Labels received by 9:00 PM Pakistan time are dispatched the same day. Labels received after 9:00 PM are dispatched the next working day.

items.title: Original labels
items.body: Original courier labels are used wherever a product requires them. On selected products an original FedEx label can be arranged. Ask on WhatsApp for the current charge.

items.title: Your labels, your responsibility
items.body: Our responsibility for a label ends once it is scanned and accepted by the courier. We accept no responsibility for counterfeit or invalid labels, or for anything that happens with a parcel after courier acceptance. Delays, losses and courier decisions rest with the courier and the seller.

items.title: No warehouse address on labels
items.body: Never put a warehouse address on a label you create. Parcels carrying a warehouse address on a self-created label will not be shipped.

items.title: Check within 72 hours
items.body: Check every label within 72 hours of sending it to us. If a label has not scanned or there is any issue, tell us inside that window. After 72 hours we take no responsibility for unscanned labels.

items.title: Labels bought through us
items.body: If you buy labels through us, delivery outcomes on those labels (damage, wrong-address delivery or parcels stuck in transit) remain the seller’s responsibility.

items.title: Advance payment
items.body: Every order is paid in full in advance. Send your payment confirmation together with your labels. No payment, no dispatch.

items.title: PKR payments
items.body: If you pay in PKR, the amount is calculated at the exchange rate of the day of payment. Short payments from a different conversion rate are not accepted.

items.title: No returns service
items.body: We do not provide a return management service, and returns or exchanges are not accepted.

items.title: Wrong item or short quantity
items.body: If the wrong item is sent or the quantity is short, a solution is provided only with solid proof: an unboxing video plus the buyer’s chat and order details. Without that proof, no solution can be offered.

items.title: Damaged parcels
items.body: Damage in transit is a matter between the seller and the courier company. We do not cover damaged parcels.

items.title: Who we answer to
items.body: We are responsible only to our direct customer: you. We have no responsibility toward your buyers or any party further down the chain.
